items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: who were the trumpet players...Eddie Preston, Nat Howard

ctx.x: Norris Turney, Clifford Jordan, Russ Andrews...somebody else, I can't think of who it was, in the saxophone section. Anyway, mmm, who were the trumpet players...Eddie Preston, Nat Howard...I'm trying to think of the trumpet players... Oh boy. This ain't me today.
You also played at the Half Note with that band.
